items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Kirkaby was glad to get me out of the band.

ctx.x: (Laughs.) Well, we'll get around to that one in a little while.
Well now Fats had Ed to take care of his business, some business for him, for him, and Ed moved in
there to -- smooth operator. He was working for Victor. Victor had to let him go. He almost owned Victor.
